tweets.text: Managing multiple CLI auth profiles is painful. I built ContextCLI — run any dev CLI under a named profile. Integrates perfectly with your current agentic development workflow too! Open source (MIT): http://github.com/owenisas/contextcli… Follow and comment for app support request.
Surely will maintain regularly if at least 100 people star the project, LOL
